title: 送还皮笔记本  (Returning the Notebook)

segments.t: Qing climbs up to the attic door to return Hao's forgotten leather notebook, trying hard to sound normal despite thinking he inspects hotels for a living. Listen first.
打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
'Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.' Knocking on a guest's door starts politely with
打扰一下
literally 'disturb a moment', softer and more respectful than 'hey'.
啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
'Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.' Handy two-character word:
到处
joins 'arrive' and 'place' to mean 'everywhere'—looking in every spot.
这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
'All my street notes from this week are inside—thanks to you.' Warm gratitude word:
多亏
means 'thank goodness for' or 'all thanks to', crediting someone who saved the day.
听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
'I heard it! It sounded like the hot-water pipe in the bathroom next door.' Compound building at its clearest:
热水管
stacks 'hot' + 'water' + 'pipe' in plain logical order.
我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
'I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.' Vivid everyday image:
水龙头
calls a bathroom tap a 'water dragon-head', since traditional spouts were shaped like dragon heads.
我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
'I have a thick quilt on my bed, so sleeping tonight is very comfortable.' Cozy bedroom word:
被子
means a quilt or comforter, while 'comfortable' at the end describes how nice it feels.
谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
'Thank you for being so understanding! Chen will check the basement right away.' Thoughtful praise:
体谅
literally 'put yourself in someone's shoes and forgive', means 'be understanding'.
晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
'Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.' Evening farewell
晚安
joins 'evening' with 'peace'—literally 'peaceful night' for 'good night'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
这一周的街道记录全在里面，多亏了你。
很高兴我们安静的小院子适合您的……工作。
非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
听到了！好像是隔壁洗手间的热水管响了。
我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
啊！老水管晚上有时候会进一点空气。
我床上有厚被子，今晚睡着很舒服。
谢谢您这么体谅！老陈马上去地下室检查。
晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
Hao got his notebook back without suspecting a thing, yet that cooling bathroom hot-water pipe is a warning sign. One final scene in Episode 3—down to the basement. See you next time.
晚安，明天见！
